decision: Require the real Qubes qualification runner to consume the schema-v2 calibrated topology selection artifact and bind qualification to its exact Git SHA, winner topology ID, and canonical SHA-256 calibration evidence digest before any preflight or campaign starts.

reviews.correctness: Preferred an explicit selection-artifact binding because a qualification run that knows only the commit and Qubes endpoints cannot prove which measured resource evidence selected the deployed topology.
reviews.robustness_security: Preferred fail-before-preflight validation of schema, SHA, topology ID, and lowercase SHA-256 digest. This prevents stale or swapped calibration selection artifacts from reaching qrexec qualification and preserves the existing attestation/fencing gates.
reviews.latency_resources_regression: Preferred local artifact validation over a new evidence database or attestation service: zero additional qrexec round trips, negligible CPU/memory, and no MissionQueue/coordinator mutation-semantic changes.

alternatives_rejected: Pass only the digest as an environment string: weaker because it does not bind the digest to the selection schema, winner topology, and commit as one artifact.
Recompute calibration during qualification: stronger freshness but duplicates expensive Qube workloads, increases resource contention, and can select a different topology between phases.
External evidence database/attestation service: useful later for audit history, but adds credentials, lifecycle, latency, and failure modes before real Qubes qualification is established.
qa: Accept schema-v2 selection only when Git SHA, winner topology ID, and 64-character lowercase SHA-256 digest match deployment expectations.
Reject wrong Git SHA before qrexec preflight.
Reject wrong topology ID before qrexec preflight.
Reject malformed or legacy calibration evidence digest before qrexec preflight.
failure_lessons: A content digest returned by calibration selection is not a release gate until the qualification authority consumes and validates it.
Binding must happen before any Qubes workload or qualification traffic so configuration drift fails without producing partial evidence.
